---
title: Appendix and supplementary sections without number-sections
author: Test Author
number-sections: false
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: article
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: With number-sections set to false, an article keeps its numbered body headings and the Appendix A and S1 headings, and the sub-headings of the appendix and the supplementary section have no number.
        check: bash _checks/extras.sh sections-unnumbered
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
---

# Results

The body of the article.

# Extra {.appendix}

The analyses that support the results.

## Sub one

The first appendix section.

# More {.supplementary}

The material that did not fit in the article.

## Sub two

The first supplementary section.
